image_description: A medium shot of two people in costume at an outdoor event. The primary subject is a person on the right wearing a shiny, silver-colored breastplate armor with a green hood and a black helmet. To the left, another person with blonde hair is visible from the back/side, wearing a purple garment with a black collar. In the background, there are buildings, flags, and other people, suggesting a fair or festival setting.
